src: const k = sketch('top'); k.rect(60, 40, { at: [0, 0] }); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('front'); sk.polygon([[-7.6,17.4],[-11,17.4],[-11,25.3],[-7.6,25.3]]); sk.round(4, 1.4); groove(sk, t, 270);
